spine: 1. Log 的基本操作是 append，R2 不支援 append，所以 K2 把寫入單位改成夠大的完整 segment 檔。
2. 副本與共識整個交給 R2，應用層只處理 log 語意，這是 K2 宣稱 radically simpler 的來源。
3. 寫入路徑是 edge service 記憶體批次加短暫等待再寫 segment；等待就是約 1 秒 p99 延遲的一部分，耐久性邊界落在哪一刻文章沒說。
4. 順序與嚴格遞增的 offset 靠 R2 原子操作，無獨立協調服務；key-based ordering 與更高寫入平行度在路線圖上，目前沒有。
5. 消費端是 subscription 加 5 分鐘 lease，ack、nack、extend 三個出口；批次為單位意味著沒有訊息層級重試。
6. 價格表與限制接起來：讀取費隨 subscription 數倍增，儲存上限 10 GB 比寫入速率更先卡住真實負載。
7. 與 Queues、Pipelines 的邊界文章明講；與 Kafka 只有部署環境的論證與路線圖相容性，沒有逐項對照，不能編造。

perspective.mechanism: 在不支援 append 的物件儲存上做 log：記憶體批次、整批寫成 segment、順序與 offset 由 R2 原子操作決定，副本與共識交給儲存層；消費端以 subscription 與 5 分鐘 lease 運作。
perspective.tradeoff: 用約 1 秒的 p99 produce 延遲、批次層級重試、目前單 stream 30 MB/s 與 10 GB 儲存上限，換取不必維運 broker 叢集。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣後端工程師用延遲容忍度、是否需要訊息級重試、是否需要 key 保序、流量與儲存量、subscription 切法五條來評估 K2 是否適合。

notes.quote: producers and consumers must align in scale and in time
notes.interpretation: 文章以 RPC 架構下生產端與消費端必須在規模與時間上對齊作為問題起點；K2 位於兩端之間是本文的讀法。

notes.quote: Under the hood, K2 implements a partitioned, durable log on top of R2 object storage
notes.interpretation: K2 是蓋在 R2 上的 partitioned durable log；partition 如何劃分文章引用段落未說。

notes.quote: extremely durable storage (11 9s!)
notes.interpretation: 耐久性來自 R2；本文推測該數字描述寫入 R2 之後的物件（推測，已在文中標記）。

notes.quote: Offloading replication and consensus to the storage layer allows us to make the application layer (K2 in this case) radically simpler, cheaper, and higher performance.
notes.interpretation: 副本與共識交給儲存層，是 K2 簡化應用層的理由；形容詞為文章宣稱，無附對照量測。

notes.quote: does not support appends, the standard operation on a log
notes.interpretation: R2 沒有 append，是 K2 必須改變寫入單位的原因。

notes.quote: we must write complete files, or segments, that are large enough to overcome the cost of writing and reading each one
notes.interpretation: segment 要夠大才攤得平單次讀寫成本；因此必須先湊批。segment 實際大小文章未公開。

notes.quote: We do this by first accumulating writes in-memory on an edge service. After waiting a short period for data to arrive, we write all events as a segment file.
notes.interpretation: 寫入路徑：edge service 記憶體累積，短暫等待後整批寫成 segment 檔。等待時間文章未公開。

notes.quote: We achieve ordering and strictly incrementing offsets using R2's atomic operations without needing a separate coordination service.
notes.interpretation: 順序與 offset 靠 R2 原子操作，無獨立協調服務；具體是哪種原子操作文章未說。

notes.quote: Writing to object storage is slower than a local disk, and we have to wait for the local batch to accumulate before starting the write. In our initial release of K2, this adds up to about 1 second of produce latency at the 99th percentile of response times.
notes.interpretation: 第一版 K2 的 p99 produce 延遲約 1 秒，原因是物件儲存較慢加上等待批次湊齊。回應何時回傳為本文推測。

notes.quote: you can use whatever format or encoding makes sense for your application
notes.interpretation: K2 以 bytes 表示資料，不規定格式；生產端經 HTTP API 或 Worker binding（同段原文：via an HTTP API or Worker binding）。

notes.quote: scaling out to multiple readers to handle more load than a single server can manage
notes.interpretation: subscription 帶來 read parallelism。

notes.quote: a lease for that particular batch of events for 5 minutes
notes.interpretation: consume 取得一批事件的 5 分鐘 lease；過期行為與 extend 長度文章未說。

notes.quote: ack the batch, which marks it as processed and ensures it will not be redelivered
notes.interpretation: ack 後不重新投遞。

notes.quote: nack (negative ack) it, meaning we've failed to process it and would like it to be redelivered
notes.interpretation: nack 表示處理失敗並希望重新投遞；lease 到期後回到可投遞狀態為本文推測。

notes.quote: extend its lease, in case it needs more time to complete processing
notes.interpretation: extend 用於需要更多處理時間；一次延長多久文章未說。

notes.quote: splitting work amongst multiple consumers such that each consumer gets a portion of the data
notes.interpretation: 共用 subscription 時 consumer 各拿一部分資料；分配規則文章未說。

notes.quote: a separate subscription for each consumer — the pub/sub pattern — in which case each consumer sees all of the messages
notes.interpretation: 各自一個 subscription 即 pub/sub，每個 consumer 看到全部訊息；文章也提到可混用多個獨立 consumer pool（原文 multiple independent consumer pools）。本文只引用不含破折號的片段。

notes.quote: tracking individual items of expensive or time consuming work that need to be asynchronously completed
notes.interpretation: Queues 的重心是一件一件的工作；同段列出 complex logic on the grain of a particular work item, like retries, delays, and dead-letter queues。

notes.quote: designed for high-scale data movement, long-term retention, and fan-out consumption
notes.interpretation: K2 的設計目標；同段說明訊息以批次生產與消費。

notes.quote: efficient processing at the expense of message-level retries
notes.interpretation: 批次處理換來效率，代價是沒有訊息層級重試；同段原文 Messages are produced and consumed as batches。整批重送需冪等為本文推論。

notes.quote: We recommend Pipelines when the end result is writing your events to object storage or Iceberg tables, and K2 when doing custom processing or writing to other destinations.
notes.interpretation: Pipelines 與 K2 的選用建議。

notes.quote: Pipelines runs on the Cloudflare edge, which spans a huge number of servers across over 335 cities. Our unique architecture means we often cannot run traditional distributed systems software like Kafka
notes.interpretation: 不直接跑 Kafka 的理由是 Cloudflare edge 的部署形狀；同一條 stream 寫入可能經不同伺服器為本文推論。

notes.quote: Drop-in support for Apache Kafka clients
notes.interpretation: Kafka 客戶端相容列在路線圖，目前沒有；同一份路線圖另列 Higher write parallelism, up to multi-GB/s streams、Message keys and key-based ordering guarantees、Express tier with lower produce and end-to-end latencies。

notes.quote: Maximum of 10GB of storage used
notes.interpretation: 文章列出的儲存上限；同段列出 30 MB/s produce per stream。

notes.quote: 30 MB/s produce per stream
notes.interpretation: 單一 stream 目前的寫入上限。

notes.quote: Data Produced | $0.04 / GB
notes.interpretation: 價格表：同表另有 Data Consumed $0.04 / GB 與 Data Retained $0.02 / GB / month。月費估算（30 天、穩態、每個 subscription 讀全部一次）為本文算術。

notes.quote: "retention_seconds": 604800
notes.interpretation: 文章示範設定中的保留秒數，604800 秒等於 7 天；本文不稱其為預設值。

notes.quote: By decoupling producers and consumers at the edge, K2 enables durable, ordered log streams without the operational overhead of traditional broker clusters.
notes.interpretation: 文章宣稱 K2 在不需傳統 broker 叢集維運的前提下提供持久、有序的 log stream；這是廠商自述，不是獨立量測。

notes.quote: If your producers send too much data for your consumers to handle or if your consumers or downstream services become unavailable, events are dropped.
notes.interpretation: 文章用來說明直接 RPC 呼叫的失敗模式，作為需要中間緩衝的理由。

notes.quote: It's fully serverless, scales to vast quantities of data, and supports long-term retention.
notes.interpretation: 文章描述 K2 為完全 serverless；同為廠商自述。
